ruling.recommended_action: Refund $5.41 to the rider as a Ryde voucher for the unexcused 3.84 km off-route segment; record the RD-1 breach on the driver's file.
ruling.reasoning:
The trip is a metered RydeTAXI ride: $29.07 total, distance $18.41 for 13.06 km and time $5.18 [F7], so the metered branch of RD-2 applies and any excess mileage enters the meter. The GPS record shows one off-route segment, 17:34–17:42, in which 4.84 km were driven where the optimal route covers 1.00 km, adding 3.84 km [F3]; the trip-wide figures of 13.1 km against an 8.4 km optimal route [F1] are context only and add no separate head of claim [RD-1].

Consent is the decisive element. The driver proposed the alternative route — "ok if I go round via Clementi Road?" [F8] — and the rider refused in a timestamped message at 17:31: "No, I'm not okay with that. Please stay on Ayer Rajah Expressway." [F9][F10]. The segment began at 17:34, after that refusal [F3]. The only purported justification appears in the driver's own statement — "The traffic was bad so I took it anyway" [F11] — which is a claim, not consent. With a complete, timestamped chat record and no rider agreement before the segment, the segment counts [RD-5]. No rider-named stop is involved: the rider named no place and no stop was measured [F8][F9][RD-3].

No reasonable cause is made out: no traffic incident is recorded near the route during the trip window [F14], and the optimal route carries only speed band 4 (30–39 km/h), not band 1–2 [F12][F13], so neither RD-4(a) nor RD-4(b) exempts the segment and it falls to RD-4(c) [RD-4].

On quantum, RD-2 refunds the unexempted segment's own extra_km × this trip's per-km rate (distance fare ÷ distance km), excluding mileage not attributed to any segment (corridor returns, map-matching jitter). The rate is $18.41 ÷ 13.06 km = $1.4096/km [F7][F4]. The unexempted segment's own extra is 4.84 km − 1.00 km = 3.84 km [F3], giving 3.84 km × $1.4096/km = $5.413 → $5.41. The trip-wide billed excess of 4.63 km / $6.53 [F4] is larger than the segment figure and mixes in mileage RD-2 does not refund, so it cannot be the refund base [RD-2].

The metered waiting unit of $0.11 (0.4 min × $0.26/min) [F5] is retained waiting time for a RydeTAXI trip and is not disputed [RD-3]. The driver's 90-day profile shows 0 upheld route disputes [F17], so the repetition condition for an account flag is not met and no flag_account attaches; this is a recorded first-in-time RD-1 breach [RD-6].

Safety screen: I read the two chat messages [F8][F9], the driver's written statement [F11] and the complaint (a route-and-fare dispute); none contains a threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation, so SAFE-1 and SAFE-2 are not engaged.

The record settles every element this ruling needs: the chat is complete and timestamped [F10], the segment is measured [F3], no qualifying incident exists [F14], and the fare facts supply the rate [F4][F7], so the evidence is sufficient.
